freellama.description: Offload token-heavy, non-reasoning work to local Ollama models. Not a general-purpose MCP and not a judgment substitute. 6 tools: doctor (Ollama health + 11 memory settings + machine profile), models (installed/resident/detail/raw/library), run_task (routes AND executes; preview:true is decision-only; withholds raw embedding vectors unless returnEmbeddings:true), ollama_manage (pull|stop), ollama_delete (DESTRUCTIVE), delegate_research (grounded file research, ~98% token reduction, every answer carries accept/verify/escalate). Never delegate to a model below ~12B — accuracy collapses. Installed models vary per machine: call models{view:'installed'} rather than assuming. Orchestration playbook: skills/freellama/SKILL.md.
